style_summary: Adult original-character posters on flat acid-yellow fields with extreme fisheye distortion: frame-breaking black type, wet blue brush gestures, magenta splatter, flat flower shapes and local hand-drawn RGB misregistration build a high-tension structure.

environment_variables.STYLE_FIDELITY_ANCHORS: Runtime shared CORE and FLEX rules
environment_variables.SOURCE_CONTENT_TO_AVOID: Runtime exclusions from all four references
environment_variables.SUBJECT: Original adult identity and fully covered clothing
environment_variables.DESIGN_DIRECTION: Title, hero and graphic device composition, including landscape adaptation

style_fidelity_anchors: [CORE] Original adult anime street-action character key art with extreme fisheye foreshortening, tilted axes and open-mouth exertion, never calm portraiture.
[CORE] Acid lime and flat lemon yellow form the ground, black structural letters and brackets anchor it, cobalt blue carries motion and hot magenta carries fluid impacts.
[CORE] Use thick irregular hand-inked contours and simple one-shadow cel planes for characters, with loose red-green-cyan separated sketch contours visibly concentrated along selected edges.
[CORE] Wet cobalt/lime brush swipes and coarse halftone patches occupy substantial local motion wedges, while broad flat fields remain untextured.

[CORE] Giant cropped heavy upright Latin sans name letters become tilted perspective apertures interlocking with the figure, black broken corner brackets, splatter and oversized flat petal impact discs.
[CORE] Keep 15–22% quiet flat field, at least four overlapping planes, violent near/far scale jumps and asymmetrical edge exits; no tidy poster margins.
[FLEX] Shift the title, figure mass and impact device each case while keeping palette roles, diffuse flat light and the common aperture/brush/offset-line vocabulary.
[FLEX] Adapt the action to both ratios with a fresh composition, preserving the character and readable short name rather than cropping a finished image.
source_content_to_avoid: All existing IP characters including Zenless Zone Zero and Corin Wickes; no copied face, hair or costume.
R1 maid headdress, screw props and original katakana glyph shapes.
R2 cap plus headphones pose, underboob and exposed torso framing.
R3 round goggles plus OK-hand over eye and cleavage emphasis.
R4 sunglasses plus finger-in-mouth; no mouth-touching hand gesture.
No source words, signatures, signature-like tags, dates, creator marks or logos, including ZENLESS ZONE ZERO, CORIN WICKES and bachser-like scrawls.

visual_deconstruction.genre: Original adult anime street-action character key art, not advertising slogan layouts.

energy.density: 78–85% active surface, 15–22% flat quiet field; reference quiet estimates R1 22%, R2 3%, R3 9%, R4 32%.
energy.layering: Four or five interpenetrating planes: ground, structural letter/bracket, figure, brush/flower, local splatter.
energy.disorder: Intentional loose contour construction, local RGB misregistration, wet brush edges; no uniform grit.
energy.tension: Extreme near/far enlargement, overhead fisheye, tilted axes, open-mouth action and hard frame exits are essential.

fusion.genre: All four: anime adult character key art; replace all identities.
fusion.palette: R1 acid lime/magenta/black, R2 cobalt, R4 yellow, R3 cream/orange flat impact shapes.
fusion.finish: R3 thick flat ink base + R4 loose RGB sketch edges; R2 wet brush and halftone restricted to motion wedges. Do not blend into glossy painted faces.
fusion.type: R1 cropped black heavy graphic type transformed into readable Latin perspective apertures.
fusion.layout: R3 fisheye and R1 graphic interlock, with R4 severe close crop and R2 sweeping momentum.
fusion.secondary: R1 black brackets and fluid splash; R3 flower shape transformed to isolated impact disc.
fusion.balance: Each case shows all four contributions; R1 contributes roughly 30%, R2 25%, R3 25%, R4 20% of visible style.

grammar: Foreshortening, flat ink, coarse halftone, print misregistration

signature.R1: Maid/screws and katakana sidewall replaced by adult work equipment and Latin aperture letters.
signature.R2: Cap/headphones and exposed-torso leap replaced by practical full clothing and job-driven action, strokes form local wedges.
signature.R3: Goggles/OK-hand/flower wreath replaced by tool-scale fisheye and separated petal impact discs.
signature.R4: Sunglasses/mouth gesture/sideways glamour crop replaced by exposed eyes, shouting exertion and offset lines on equipment and sleeves.

visual_deconstruction.series_constants: Same lime/yellow ground, black type/brackets, cobalt motion, magenta fluid, orange/cream petals, diffuse flat light. A kit of apertures rather than repeated layout.

composition.ratio_pair: 9:16 / 16:9, user requested; generate natively, never pad or crop
composition.structure: Graphic type, brackets and flat fields occupy at least 30% visually; no decorative microtitle.
composition.placement: Left vertical / bottom perspective ramp / upper broken beam / crossing diagonal; hero right / diagonal-left / left-centre / lower-left with right prop.

typography.class: Very heavy upright block grotesk sans, Latin uppercase; large perspective distortions allowed, not italic script or serif.
typography.primary: Only MAIN_TEXT is required text, spell each glyph exactly; partial overlap allowed while still readable.
typography.texture: No texture wording needed; never include any signature tag.

color_palette.character: deep teal hair, warm skin, cream/cobalt clothing; red/green/cyan only as local narrow offset lines

image_treatment.base: Uneven thick black hand ink, flat cel fill with one hard shadow, loose construction lines; no soft face gradients, lens blur, glow or glossy game render.
image_treatment.local_effects: Wet swipes and coarse dots on 20–30% surface, roughly 2–5px dots at 1k short side; RGB offsets 1–4px at 1k along 15–25% contours. Magenta splatter clean fluid silhouettes; black ink edges stay slightly alive.
image_treatment.light: Neutral diffuse graphic lighting, same across all cases; no volumetric effects.

design_rules: Character is always the main focal point despite near-lens props.
Structural huge letters interlock with character and motion, never small captions.
Keep all four reference contributions visible in every sample.
Preserve 15–22% flat quiet surface and local texture containment.
Adults fully clothed in practical action; no erotic crop.
Primary name must remain readable letter by letter; source wording and signature tags forbidden.
do: Use extreme scale jumps and hard crop.
Give every case a new title/hero/device arrangement.
Review glyphs enlarged and compare finish to each source.
avoid: Calm polished portrait with decorative name.
All-over distressed texture or smooth glossy anime game shading.
Copied signature pairings, costume silhouettes or source content.
negative_prompt: Existing IP characters, source costumes/poses/names, maid headdress, screw props, cap and headphones, goggles, sunglasses, OK hand, fingers in mouth, cleavage emphasis, underboob, minors, fan-service, signatures, dates, watermark, faux creator tag, calm central portrait, tiny title, polished 3D anime, soft glow, blurry depth of field, uniform distressed texture, extra fingers, illegible name.

values.SUBJECT: A 32-year-old woman cable rigger, short deep-teal swept hair with one shaved temple, strong adult face, amber eyes; fully zipped cream utility coverall with cobalt shoulder pads and black work gloves. No hat, eyewear or headphones.
values.SUBJECT_ACTION: Overhead 14mm fisheye: she shouts while hurling a large smooth open-centred cable reel toward the bottom-left lens; her far body recedes to the upper right. One hand grips the reel hub, the other pulls a cable taut. Big tool-to-body scale jump.
values.DESIGN_DIRECTION: Hero upper/right, enormous reel lower-left; IONA runs tall vertically down left as individual readable giant black letters, partly behind cable; broken black brackets anchor opposite corners. Blue wet brush wedge right; magenta splash flies from reel edge; one giant flat orange/cream flower impact cropped at top. For landscape expand reel left to hero right; keep title vertical on left, no centered layout.

values.SUBJECT: A 29-year-old male urban kite racer with copper buzzcut, dark brown skin, adult angular face, teal eyebrows; opaque high-neck cobalt/cream windbreaker, full black trousers, substantial boots and lime harness, no headwear or eyewear.
values.SUBJECT_ACTION: Near-vertical top-down fisheye sees his entire body diving diagonally, knees bent at different depths; a huge angular kite control bar thrusts toward upper-right lens, the far boots are tiny, face shouting in exhilaration. No cap/headphones or bare torso.
values.DESIGN_DIRECTION: Slim full figure lower-left to upper-middle, bar very large upper-right. RUKA is a massive tilted black name ramp along bottom/right, with leg occluding only a small letter edge. Blue wet brush crescent top-left; magenta splash follows kite cable; bold flat orange/cream petal disc below left hand. Landscape recompose long diagonal across frame, title low-right, brush top-left.

values.SUBJECT: A 36-year-old muscular woman street percussionist, plum-black short curly hair, tan skin, broad adult face; opaque cream high-neck sleeveless sports tunic over cobalt long sleeves, loose black trousers, no cap, headphones or goggles.
values.SUBJECT_ACTION: Violent oblique overhead fisheye: face and torso left/centre yelling in effort, huge padded drum mallet punches toward right lens, second hand strikes a waist-strapped barrel drum in lower-left. Exaggerated near hand and mallet but anatomically clear.
values.DESIGN_DIRECTION: TAVI stretches as giant black letters across a broken upper beam behind raised arm, still readable. Drum lower-left, huge mallet right, hero left; a big flat orange/cream flower impact disc bottom-right. Cobalt wet swipes and coarse halftone follow the mallet arc, magenta droplets cross the letter aperture; RGB sketch edges on drum and sleeves. Landscape expands the mallet across right half, keeps upper split title.

values.SUBJECT: A 48-year-old woman festival caller with silver cropped hair, one dark teal streak, deep warm brown skin, adult facial lines; cobalt high collar rain jacket with cream panels, completely closed, black gloves. No eyewear, hat or headset.
values.SUBJECT_ACTION: BOLD ultra-wide fisheye close-up: her shouting face anchors lower-left while a huge faceted handheld megaphone bell leaps into upper-right foreground, about half the frame; she grips its handle far from her mouth. Full shoulder gesture pulls diagonally across the frame, no fingers near lips.
values.DESIGN_DIRECTION: NERI forms a huge diagonal black name beam upper-left to centre, crossing behind the megaphone bell; preserve every letter identity. Black brackets are dislocated near left/top and lower/right. A broad blue wet fan with halftone emerges lower-left; magenta paint ribbons arc beyond the bell, giant flat orange/cream flower disc is cut by bottom-right edge. Landscape puts bell on right and face left, diagonal name crosses upper-left to middle; harder scale jump than the references.
